Contact the office for an inspection appointment: 732-892-0638, 83 Bridge Ave, Bay Head.

Bay Head also has a separate Rental Certificate of Occupancy (rental registration) for rentals, including seasonal rentals; that is not a resale item.

requirements: Smoke alarms on every living level including the basement, and within 10 feet of bedrooms on levels with bedrooms
All smoke alarms, including hardwired, must be under 10 years old
Battery-only smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed battery units (since January 1, 2019); homes built before 1978 need at least one on each level
Homes built 1978 to 1983 need hardwired alarms on each level; 1984 to 1990 interconnected hardwired alarms with battery backup on each level; 1991 and later also in every bedroom
Hardwired alarms that need replacing must be replaced with hardwired alarms, not battery alarms
Carbon monoxide alarm near the sleeping areas if the home has a fuel-burning appliance or an attached garage; battery and plug-in CO alarms should be under 5 years old

Homes with a generator, solar panels or battery storage need a printed caution label (for example CAUTION: MULTIPLE SOURCES OF POWER) within 18 inches of the main electrical panel and the electric meter
A monitored low-voltage fire alarm system needs an NFPA 72 test report sent to the Fire Marshal before closing
Portable fire extinguishers are no longer required (as of February 3, 2025)
Do not mount alarms in unfinished attics, garages, stairwells, the top of basement stairs or kitchens

fire_cert.notes: The Ocean County Fire Marshal is Bay Head's fire code enforcing agency (registry code C) and its Resale and Rental Home Inspections page lists Bay Head for resales and rentals of 1-2 family buildings. The Borough's Code Enforcement page links to the Ocean County Fire Marshal, and the Borough's transfer application must include the fire inspection. The Fire Marshal's certificate is valid 12 months from the inspection. Its February 2025 requirements sheet says portable fire extinguishers are no longer required and adds the secondary power source label; the certificate is still called CSACMAPFEC on that sheet. The state directory lists a smoke detector compliance phone of (732) 331-8152 for Bay Head; the Fire Marshal's own page gives (732) 929-2088 for resale and rental inspections, which is used here.
